questions.title: # Open questions
questions.help: Answer under each question by filling its lines; leave a line empty to skip it. Give the chosen option and the reason to finish a decision (add the rejected alternatives and set the State to validated to validate it). Then run `answers` (/runiacorp-plugin:decisions-answers). Do not edit the `<!-- q:… -->` markers.
